Challenging judgment and award dated 12.01.2011 passed by I Additional Senior Civil Judge and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi in MVC No.146/2008, this appeal is filed by appellant-insurer.

entities.text: I Additional Senior Civil Judge and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Smt. Anusha, learned counsel appearing for Shri S.K.Kayakamath, advocate for appellant- insurer at outset submitted that only ground on which impugned award is challenged by insurer is alleging violation of policy condition as vehicle involved in accident was a goods tempo and driver of said vehicle was holding driving license to drive light motor vehicle (LMV) without transport endorsement.

3. However in view of authoritative pronouncement by Hon'ble Supreme Court in case of Mukund Dewangan vs. Oriental Insurance Company Limited, (2017) 14 Supreme Court Cases 663, wherein it is held that driver holding driving licence for driving light motor vehicle (LMV) would be authorized to drive any vehicle with less than 7,500 k.gs in gross vehicle weight, insurer cannot escape liability.

entities.text: Mukund Dewangan vs. Oriental Insurance Company Limited, (2017) 14 Supreme Court Cases 663
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Consequently, appeal being devoid of merit is dismissed.
5. Amount in deposit is ordered to be transmitted to tribunal for payment.
